title: axonopus hydrolithicus
intro: Axonopus hydrolithicus, commonly known as Axonopus, is a species of grass belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Axonopus hydrolithicus include wound healing, anti-allergic effects, and the potential to lower blood sugar levels.
